expectedIntentBehavior.why: Explain which supplied signals caused or contributed to the review recommendation, and label any inferred explanation.
expectedIntentBehavior.evidence: Return source-addressable supporting and contradictory observations plus evidence gaps.
expectedIntentBehavior.compare: Compare escalate-now against wait-and-recheck using supplied decision criteria.
expectedIntentBehavior.challenge: Construct the strongest reasonable case against escalation and identify what would strengthen that countercase.
expectedIntentBehavior.confidence: Describe uncertainty type and basis; do not invent a calibrated percentage.
expectedIntentBehavior.provenance: Trace recorded data sources and transformations to the decision output; mark unrecorded segments unknown.
